prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 课程表 · 连堂与午休 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "数学（连堂）" spans 1 col × 2 row; "物理实验：测量重力加速度" spans 1 col × 2 row; "12:00–13:30 午餐与午休，图书馆开放" spans 5 col × 1 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "节次" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "周一" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 92px
  col 3: header "周二" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 169px
  col 4: header "周三" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "周四" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 184px
  col 6: header "周五" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示一周各节课程、连堂安排和统一的午餐与午休时段。","reading":"读者先按节次横向查找各日课程，也会沿某一天纵向查看安排；跨行课程应能清楚对应两个节次，午休则作为全周共同的时间分隔。","groups":["第一列是节次索引，应与课程列区分；周一至周五是同一层级的日期列，供横向比较。","周二和周四含较长课程名称，需要更多换行空间；周一和周四的跨行课程可利用两节课合并后的高度。","午休内容横跨五个日期列，可利用合并后的宽度自然换行。"],"keep_intact":["节次和星期标题","课程名称中的词语与标点关系","时间范围 12:00–13:30","连堂课程与其跨越的两个节次之间的对应关系"],"may_wrap":["较长的课程名称可按中文语义自然换行","午餐与午休说明可在时间范围之后自然换行","跨行课程名称可利用合并单元格的高度换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [67, 52, 70, 52, 66, 52] · table 360×355px · row heights [36, 88, 88, 36, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [67, 52, 85, 52, 51, 52] · table 360×472px · row heights [60, 146, 146, 36, 83] · column headers wrapped 1/6 · tallest cell 12 lines · mid-word splits 1
Design r2C: widths [54, 52, 83, 52, 66, 52] · table 360×332px · row heights [36, 88, 88, 36, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"节次和星期标题均保持完整；各节次横向可辨，午休说明横跨工作日并保持在一行。周一、周四的连堂课程也能对应两节课。","problems":"周二第三节的课程名称被切成多行，词组衔接不够自然；周四的实验名称排列得很窄，标点和词语的关系较零碎，拉高了前两节课。","cause":"周二宽70px，仅有49px的文字空间；周四宽66px，仅有45px的文字空间。两列都承担较长内容，而其他日期列已接近容纳两个汉字所需的宽度。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"周二宽85px，第三节长课程名称的行数减少，词组也更容易连贯阅读；节次列保持完整。","problems":"周四标题断成两行，实验名称几乎逐字竖排，标点孤立，导致前两节异常高大；第三节“生物”也断开。整张表的高度和列间节奏因此失衡。","cause":"为周二增加宽度后，周四缩至51px，文字空间只有30px，低于两个汉字所需的约31px；跨两行的实验名称进一步放大了这一限制。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"周二比r2A更宽，第三节长课程的换行较从容；星期标题完整，午休说明保持在一行，整体高度也有所降低。","problems":"第一、二、三节的行标题都被拆开，削弱了作为横向查找起点的节次索引；周四实验名称仍然狭窄，前两节高度仍由它主导。","cause":"节次列从67px缩至54px，文字空间只有33px，无法容纳约46px的三字节次；周四仍为66px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"平衡周二","widths":[67,52,74,52,62,52],"change":"保留完整节次，将周二从70px增至74px，改善第三节长课程的断行；周四减至62px，仍保留容纳两个汉字的空间，并利用连堂单元格的高度。"},{"name":"优先实验","widths":[67,52,66,52,70,52],"change":"保留完整节次，把部分宽度转给周四，观察实验名称能否形成更连贯的词组并改善前两节的高度；周二仍有45px文字空间。"},{"name":"强化连堂","widths":[67,52,62,52,74,52],"change":"进一步拓宽周四，测试跨两行的实验课程是否能明显改善前两节的整体节奏；周二保留41px文字空间，比较第三节增加的换行是否值得。"}]}
